hypothesis: Separate causal online ratings for win, top-two, top-three, start timing, and exhibition timing expose dynamic racer abilities hidden by a single overall finish-order rating.

rating_dimensions.name: win
rating_dimensions.update_ranks: winner rank 0; other five tied rank 1

rating_dimensions.name: top2
rating_dimensions.update_ranks: first two tied rank 0; other four tied rank 1

rating_dimensions.name: top3
rating_dimensions.update_ranks: first three tied rank 0; other three tied rank 1

rating_dimensions.name: start
rating_dimensions.update_ranks: ascending observed start_st with exact ties; skip unless all six finite

rating_dimensions.name: exhibition
rating_dimensions.update_ranks: ascending observed exhibition_time with exact ties; skip unless all six finite

architecture.inference: exact enumeration of all 120 ordered top-three outcomes

decision: Reject immediately after any development fold fails. Passing still requires prospective confirmation after 2026-07-11 and market comparison.
